D: An Amazon princess leaves her hidden island to stop a war she believes a god has started.
P: Serve dessert when Diana tastes ice cream for the first time in London.
S: Island platter of haloumi, feta and figs
Griddled haloumi, honey thyme feta, olives, fresh figs and warm pita.
Olives, fresh figs, feta drizzled with honey and thyme, warm pita and haloumi griddled until golden with a squeeze of lemon, all on one big platter.
Amazon spinach and leek filo pie
Spinach, leek and dill in crackling filo, cut in squares, golden as the Lasso of Truth.

Spinach, leek, dill and egg with grated parmesan, layered in buttered filo and baked golden, cut into squares. Wilt 500g spinach and squeeze dry. Soften 2 sliced leeks in 2 tbsp olive oil for 8 minutes. Mix with the spinach, a bunch of chopped dill, 2 eggs and 80g grated parmesan. Layer 6 sheets of filo brushed with 60g melted butter in a tin, spread the filling, top with 6 more buttered sheets, score into squares and bake at 190°C for 40 minutes.
Potato wedges roasted crisp in olive oil, lemon and oregano, feta crumbled over at the Great Hall.

Potato wedges roasted crisp in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano, with feta crumbled over. Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges and toss with 60ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and salt. Roast at 210C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden. Crumble 80g feta over to serve.
M: Lamb shoulder baked slow in paper with garlic, lemon, oregano and potatoes, a feast for a queen.

Lamb shoulder sealed in baking paper with garlic, lemon, oregano and potatoes, baked low until it falls apart. Rub 1.5kg lamb shoulder with 4 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of a lemon, 2 tsp dried oregano, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Sit it on 800g halved potatoes and 2 sliced onions, wrap tight in baking paper and foil and bake at 160C for 3 hours 30 minutes. Open, raise to 200C and brown for 20 minutes.
White fish, potato and tomato simmered in olive oil and lemon, crusty bread, a general's lunch.

Greek fisherman's soup: white fish, potato, onion, celery and tomato simmered in olive oil and lemon, with crusty bread. Soften 1 sliced onion and 2 celery sticks in 80ml olive oil for 6 minutes. Add 600g diced potatoes, 2 chopped tomatoes and 1.2 L fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 700g snapper fillets in chunks and simmer 6 minutes. Finish with the juice of 1 lemon and chopped parsley, and serve with crusty bread.
W: Diana's raspberry ripple ice cream cones
Homemade vanilla custard ice cream rippled with raspberry sauce.

Rich vanilla custard ice cream churned and rippled with a sharp raspberry sauce, scooped into crisp waffle cones. Heat 300ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 120g caster sugar, whisk in the hot milk and cook to 82C, stirring. Strain and chill overnight, then churn. Simmer 200g frozen raspberries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes, sieve and cool. Layer the ice cream and sauce in a container, swirl once with a knife and freeze 4 hours. Scoop into cones.
K: Chilled white wine stirred with warm honey and orange peel, old Greek oenomeli for a warrior's toast.

White wine sweetened with warm honey and orange peel, chilled and poured over ice. Warm 80g honey with the peel of an orange and 60ml water until runny, cool, then stir into a 750ml bottle of chilled dry white wine. Pour over ice with an orange twist.
